咖啡馆抢劫的事，没有媒体敢大肆报道，和剧情中一样，这才是时笙并不怎么担心的原因，前面有反派BOSS顶着，怕个叼啊！

悲剧的是，时笙的试镜的仙侠剧一直没动静，唐隐打电话过去问，才知道那个角色已经定下了。

这个结果倒是让时笙有些意外，毕竟当时宋韩对她应该算是很满意的。

“除了女三，还剩下什么角色没有？”这部仙侠剧可是会大火的，于情于理，她都不应该放过这么好的机会。

唐隐刚才已经问过那边的工作人员，直接摇头，“没了，全定了。”

宋韩的电视剧，一直都是很抢手的，说不定人家刚露出筹备新戏苗头，就有人暗戳戳的开始走后门内定了。

“女三是谁啊？”剧情里女三是个新人，后来凭着这部剧火了起来，直接跃居三线。

“林姗姗。”

“我去！”林姗姗这几天不是丑闻缠身吗？怎么还有时间去争一个女三的角色？

唐隐推了推眼镜，慢条斯理的道：“她是在针对你，他背后的人有点来头。”

“什么来头？”真要算起来，林姗姗和她也没多大仇，如今这架势，却是要你死我活啊！

唐隐看了她一眼，“陆大鹏。”

陆大鹏，房地产行业的巨鳄，他夫人的娘家还沾着政字，能不有点来头么。

“你也别想太多，最近的资源不少，我明天在给你看看。对了，今天有个酒会，公司要求你参加，还送了礼服。”唐隐将一个袋子递给时笙。

公司让艺人参加酒会还送礼服？时笙眼里明晃晃的写着不解。

“有时候公司会准备，酒会开始的时候公司会有车接你，经纪人不能跟着进去，倒时候你自己机灵点，我会在外面等着你，有什么事给我打电话。”

唐隐尽责的如同对待新人，将注意事项和时笙说了一遍，他的声音不急不缓，如缓缓流动的微风，不会让人觉得烦躁。

时笙难得没有打断他，这些事都是米兰从来没和原主说过的。

Chapter 28 The financial owner is hiding behind me (8) - "The villain BOSS is poisonous"

No media dared to report the robbery in the cafe. Just like in the plot, this is the reason why Shi Sheng is not too worried. There is a villain BOSS in front of him, so he is afraid of grabbing him!

Tragically, there was no news about the fairy tale drama that Shi Sheng was auditioning for. Tang Yin called to ask and found out that the role had been cast.

This result surprised Shi Sheng. After all, Song Han should be very satisfied with her at that time.

"Besides the third female lead, are there any other roles left?" This fairy tale drama is going to be a big hit, and she shouldn't let go of such a good opportunity.

Tang Yin had just asked the staff over there and shook his head, "No, it's all settled."

Song and Han's TV series have always been very popular. Maybe as soon as they show signs of preparing a new drama, someone will secretly start to make reservations through the back door.

"Who is the third female lead?" In the plot, the third female lead is a newcomer. Later, she became popular with this drama and jumped directly to the third line.

"Lin Shanshan."

"I'll go!" Isn't Lin Shanshan surrounded by scandals these days?How come you still have time to fight for the role of the third female lead?

Tang Yin pushed up his glasses and said slowly: "She is targeting you. The person behind him has some background."

"What's the background?" If you really think about it, Lin Shanshan doesn't have much hatred against her, but now she's in a situation where she wants you to die!

Tang Yin glanced at her and said, "Lu Dapeng."

Lu Dapeng is a giant in the real estate industry, and his wife’s natal family is still involved in politics, so maybe she has some background.

"Don't think too much. There are a lot of resources recently. I'll show you tomorrow. By the way, there is a cocktail party today. The company asked you to attend and gave you a dress." Tang Yin handed a bag to Shi Sheng.

The company lets artists attend cocktail parties and gives them dresses?Shi Sheng's eyes were filled with confusion.

"Sometimes the company will prepare. When the reception starts, the company will have a car to pick you up. The agent can't follow you in. You should be smart when it's time. I will wait for you outside. If you need anything, call me."

Tang Yin treated Shi Sheng responsibly as if he were a newbie, and told Shi Sheng the precautions. His voice was unhurried and gentle, like a slowly flowing breeze, which would not make people feel irritated.

It was rare that Shi Sheng didn't interrupt him. These were things that Milan had never told the original owner.
